note: Ziira's own message templates. {name} placeholders are the variables, in the order of `variables`. A conversational channel may start a conversation only with an approved template; the same wording is used for SMS and email. Wording lives here, as data, in every language we support.

examples: Sales were up on yesterday and 2 things need attention

en.subject: Your daily brief
en.body: Hello {name}, here is your daily brief for {business}: {summary}

sw.subject: Muhtasari wako wa kila siku
sw.body: Habari {name}, huu ni muhtasari wako wa kila siku wa {business}: {summary}

examples: Cash is short at Thika branch

en.subject: Needs your attention
en.body: Needs your attention at {business}: {summary} Open Ziira to see what to do.

sw.subject: Inahitaji umakini wako
sw.body: Inahitaji umakini wako katika {business}: {summary} Fungua Ziira uone cha kufanya.

en.subject: Payment reminder
en.body: Dear {customer}, invoice {invoice} of {amount} to {business} was due on {due_date}. Please pay at your earliest convenience. If you have already paid, thank you. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Ukumbusho wa malipo
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, ankara {invoice} ya {amount} kwa {business} ilikuwa inadaiwa tarehe {due_date}. Tafadhali lipa mapema iwezekanavyo. Kama umeshalipa, asante. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Payment due soon
en.body: Dear {customer}, a friendly reminder: invoice {invoice} of {amount} to {business} is due on {due_date}. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Malipo yanakaribia
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, ukumbusho: ankara {invoice} ya {amount} kwa {business} inadaiwa tarehe {due_date}. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

examples: Send Juma a payment reminder about 2 overdue invoices.

en.subject: Approval needed
en.body: {business}: Ziira suggests: {description} It needs your decision.

en.subject: Your verification code
en.body: Your Ziira verification code is {code}. It expires in 15 minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this message.

sw.subject: Msimbo wako wa uthibitisho
sw.body: Msimbo wako wa uthibitisho wa Ziira ni {code}. Unaisha baada ya dakika 15. Kama hukuuomba, puuza ujumbe huu.
